Before: the settings record wasn't account-scoped, so tone, suggestions and natural voice carried to the next account. Fixed: settings scoped per account, language/theme/size device-wide; tests/settings-scope.test.mjs.

Before: two-tap removes existed but chat, file and reminder deletes did not say what stays. Fixed 0765a8b: each delete says what is kept (reminders and Library files after a chat; chats keep what Orivia read after a file; phone calendar copies after a reminder). tests/deletion-consequences.test.mjs.

Before: no way for a student to leave. Fixed 0765a8b: /api/me/orgs/:id/leave (confirm required, account header, sole admin must hand over, progress removed, audited) and a two-tap Leave control with an explanation. tests/leave-organisation.test.mjs (real Better Auth + SQLite; space 403 and chat context null after leaving). Rejoining uses the normal invitation flow.
